When submitting a new text type submissions, users often found themselves editing right after submitting in order to get the formatting right (shhh, I often made this mistake myself).

As of now, there is a Preview button next to the Submit button which will send your submission to the WhoaVerse server for rendering and display it to you without actually submitting it. If you like the result, you can hit the Submit button, or, if you want to make a few changes, you can keep using the Preview button until you are happy with the result.

Thank you all who requested this feature and I'm happy to say that I learned a lot while implementing this and that I'll be happy to use this feature myself from now on :)
